items.note: On this line שור stands alone at the right edge. Its הבר does not appear here; it starts the next line, where it looks like הכר in the print. So nothing is printed at the disputed spot, which matches the empty reading.

items.line: הבר, חויר הבר, ברא תרנגול und viele andere. — Auch die zweite
items.note: The word sits in the phrase 'חזיר הבר' (wild boar). I read its second letter as ז, but in this type ז and ו look very alike, so the print could show ו (חויר). The OCR reading 'אוו' on line 1 suggests ז is misread as ו in this font.

items.line: הבר, חויר הבר, ברא תרנגול und viele andere. — Auch die zweite
items.note: The print clearly shows the two words ברא and תרנגול (wild rooster), so the reading 'nothing' is wrong. The letters match the first reading. The words could also be ordered as תרנגול ברא, because the Hebrew is set right-to-left inside German text.

items.note: After 'doch öfter' the print shows a single Hebrew word, read as נ-ו-צ-ו-ת: two vavs and a final ת rather than ה. No second word (קנמון/קינמון) appears on this line; the comma and 'entweder weil' follow directly. The next line is cut off, so a later word cannot be checked.

items.line: §. 80) durchgehends: כרכין. Am wahrscheinlichsten ist hier eine locale
items.note: This line prints only one Hebrew word, after 'durchgehends:': כ-ר-כ-י-ן, ending in a long descending final nun, not ז or ם. Both two-word readings seem to borrow a second word that is not on this line; the form after 'nur wird' sits on the next line.

items.line: כרכמיש soll aus כרך „Stadt“ und dem Nom. pr. כמיש zusammengesetzt
items.note: After 'Nom. pr.' the print shows only three letters: mem, yod, shin. There is no preceding kaf (so not כמיש, though Kemosh would be expected), and nothing follows before 'zusammengesetzt'.

items.line: Tosephot (Sebachim 113, b. s. v. אורזילא): ואותם בופלש שאנו קורין ראם
items.note: Read right to left, the print seems to show ב, then ו, then פ, ל, ש, with the vav before the pe. This matches the expected Old French transliteration 'bufles'. The small type leaves some uncertainty about the vav/pe order.

items.line: noch Andere nennen ihn טור (Taurus) und דוביא (Lorje bei Alexander
items.note: The first word is printed טור with ט, not ת. In the second word, the third letter looks rounded with no projecting base stroke, so it reads as כ rather than ב. There is only one י, so the printed form appears to be דוכיא, which may be a misprint for דוביא. The ב/כ distinction is uncertain at this resolution.
